title: Payment Operations Standard — Returned-Debit Penalty on a Restructured Payment Arrangement
content:
Returned installment payments in the last six months take installments off the restructured count of a plan under Payment Arrangements; this is the returned-debit penalty.

## Standard

The returned-debit penalty follows the plan's returned installment payments in the last six months: 3 or more take away 2 installments, one or two take away 1, and none takes away none.

The returns are the returned installment payment entries on the plan's installment history, placed in the period by the date each return was received. Periods of six months are counted in whole months back from the handling date.

## Count table

| Returned installment payments, last 6 months | Installments taken away |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 2 |
| 4 or more | 2 |

## Hypothetical histories

- Two returns, one and four months ago: 1 installment taken away.
- Three returns, all within the last five months: 2.
- One return seven months ago, none since: none.
